title: A fun experience in Seville
text: Thank you to Clara and Tony for an enjoyable experience. The market tour was informative and the cooking class was a lot of fun. The food was great and we enjoyed learning how to make tapas and paella. We would absolutely recommend this to others.

title: Excellent experience
text: Excellent experience.  The food tour was informative.  The cooking class was well organized and the food was very good.  Highly recommend it.
author: Wpgbrad

title: A fantastic experience with thoughtful attention to every dietary need
text:
What a lovely experience was this cooking class and market tour! My 12 year old son, who tends to lose focus after a while, felt entertained the entire time. The energy of these ladies is incredible, so was the tour and story about the market and its produce, and the cooking class itself. We prepared two delicious tapas and a paella valenciana.

My multiple food intolerances were absolutely no problem for them (I let them know in advance), they kept the gluten free people separate from the rest and a vegan paella was prepared for me (vegan) and a vegetarian lady. 

100% recommend if you’re loo

title: Fun cooking experience
text:
We enjoyed the tour of the market and our cooking experience. Tony and Lidia  are both knowledgeable and were fun to work with. 
We enjoyed our cooking experience and we turned out some delicious food.
author: margoc828

title: Brilliant experience!
text: We had a brilliant experience at this cooking class with Maria and Gaia. Maria and Gaia were incredible and we had such a fun time with them! Gaia led our tour and was our assistant during the cooking. She gave us lots of helpful tips about buying in the market. Gaia was kind and funny and went out of her way to cater for the groups needs. The cooking part of the class was equally as fun and was accommodating for all abilities and ages. We made a cold tomato soup, chickpea and spinach dish and a chicken paella. title: This was a great...
text: This was a great experience.  The instructor, Leo, was very engaging and got everyone involved.  Learned some new cooking techniques.  Highly recommend.
author: Emma_W

title: Super fun, hands on cooking experience
text: A very hands-on, informative, and fun cooking experience! You learn a lot about the different ingredients, when/why to use them, how to cook them, etc. It is also vegetarian/dietary restriction friendly. I am vegetarian and was able to cook a vegetarian paella. Appreciate them for accommodating! Our instructor Diana was great.
author: Shwetha

title: Awesome experience
text: One of the best experiences we had on our trip. Domi and Tony were fantastic teachers and guides. We had so much fun, learned a lot and the food was some of the best we had in Sevilla. Could not recommend more.
author: lawrencegI7812SE

title: Super Fun + Tasty
text: Super fun! Tony and Dom were great - so welcoming and knowledgeable. Recipes were delicious and easy to follow, will definitely try to re-create at home.
